I've written the round-246 plan: it fixes the open Medium, B-R243-UNDO-MARKER-FOCUS, and has C re-check my fixes to its three lesson and retro findings. Decision: **CONTINUE**. The store is untouched: HEAD `e9fb805`, empty `git status`, frozen-list check rc 0.

**Round 245.** C failed it only on two document rows (RT-LESSONS and RT-SABA, 3 Low findings). The product rows passed in the browser (G245-AUTH and STUDIO-SMOKE-245), and `browserVerified` is true. Gate 245 was skipped, so nothing was published and the baseline stays `e9fb805`. Nothing in the backlog closes from it.

**What I fixed (C re-checks only these lines):**
- **C-R245-01:** L11 and L12 in `lessons.md` get back the three rules the merge had dropped. A reported the same three independently.
- **C-R245-03:** L50's search pattern found 0 lines for conditional renders and also missed the marker flag list, which is where this bug happens. It now matches both, and it runs on the task's own files plus the callers of Undo/Redo, not the whole folder (206 hits). `lessons.md` stays at 57 lines, with 4 lines changed.
- **C-R245-02:** in retro §12, R49-T gets a concrete question for Saba with deadline RETRO 260, and GATE244-S4 gets deadline RETRO 260.

**Round 246 task:** the regression round isn't due until 2026-10-30, so round 246 is this Medium.
- **Rule:** when the focused marker flag disappears (Undo of its add, Redo of its delete, or Cut Time), focus goes to the next remaining flag by time, else the previous one, else the "Add marker" button. Focus that was somewhere else is never moved.
- **Files:** only `ArrangementMarkerRow.tsx` and `markers-ui.test.tsx` (new rows MU18–MU23), plus a new implementation doc 189. `StudioWorkspace.tsx` and the protected auth/purchase files stay frozen. `/studio-lab` stays demo-only, and the auth guard row stays in.
- **Why the fix detects focus the way it does:** Chromium 143 fires `blur` when a focused element is removed, but jsdom does not. A blur-based fix would pass the unit tests and fail in the browser. The fix records focus when React detaches the flag's ref. I printed that ordering in jsdom; for Chromium it is inferred from the browser probe ending on the right flag, and the task says so.
- **I tried the fix on a scratch copy first:**
  - The patch applies cleanly to the store tree.
  - Typecheck and Biome are clean, and the 58 related test files pass (1,115/1,115).
  - All 8 deliberately broken versions turn their expected rows red.
  - In Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, focus goes from BODY to the expected target.
- **What C checks:** 15 browser/unit/doc rows plus the RT-FIX row. Full-suite checks are left to the gate.

**New bug found:** B-R245-UNDO-GROUP-FOCUS (Medium, already in the code before this round). With a group name focused, Undo of "Group Tracks" or Redo of "Ungroup Tracks" leaves focus on BODY. It lives in `StudioWorkspace.tsx`, a different file whose focus handling is already an open question for the frontend architect. So it's scheduled as its own round after the regression round. I added it to `b-round-244-checkpoint-request.md` as question 4; it doesn't block anything.

**Next:** REGRESSION (at the first planning on or after 2026-10-30) → the group bug → SABA-B-11b stage 2b → SABA-B-10a, 10b, 9, 11c.

**Advisor:** available and consulted twice, before writing and at the end. I applied its corrections: keep the group bug out of this round, check the jsdom behaviour, label the Chromium inference, and add question 4 to the checkpoint file.
